correctness.rationale: A one-double-incidence vertex classification proves the exact Gaussian support. The joint marked density follows by order statistics. Gaussian Mills ratios prove Gumbel and independent exponential limits; conditional truncated-array CLT proves independent normal bulk. Uniform integrability of Gaussian maxima plus a normal-tail inverse expansion yields the stated sharp mean width. A separate enumerator cross-checks q=2..7; finite tests are supplementary.
